  "description": "Action Against Hunger is the world&rsquo;s hunger specialist and leader in a global movement that aims to end life-threatening hunger for good within our lifetimes. For 40 years, the humanitarian and development organization has been on the front lines, treating and preventing hunger across nearly 50 countries. It served more than 21 million people in 2018 alone.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Grants and Compliance Manager

Job Location: Maiduguri, Borno
Employment Type: Full-Time
Reporting to: Field Coordinator
Proposed start date: October 2026

Job Summary


	We are currently looking to fill the role of Grants and Compliance Manager who will be responsible for overseeing all critical aspects of the grant cycle from pre-award to post-award including donor compliance, timely and quality reporting, internal and external coordination.


Key Responsibilities
Objective 1: Support Grants management &amp; Compliance of ongoing program implementation:


	Ensure that reports (internal and external) are submitted on time and are coherent and accurately written (Biweekly, APRs, quarterly, interim and/or final report)
	Support the Field Coordinator for the collection and dissemination of various contributions from the Project Managers, review and validation by Abuja technical team, dissemination and filing of the validated report
	Maintain hard and soft files of ACF Nigeria grant portfolio documents (from inception to closure)
	Play a key role in Grant Opening and Closing meetings preparation and implementation, as well as monthly/regular grants management meetings which include representation from each unit (Admin, programs, logistics, security and M&amp;E), compile action points and ensure proper follow-up of issues raised
	Monitor and support the use of grants management tools such as the detailed implementation tool, M&amp;E plan, PFU and BFU amongst program teams to ensure accurate tracking of implementation and timely alerts to potential challenges/obstacles
	Support in project implementation and development, including making inputs in the area of risk management, quality of implementation, analysis of challenges faced during implementation, and working with various program teams and key stakeholders to resolve problems in a timely, cost-efficient, and effective manner
	In coordination with the grant Head and deputy head of department, monitor implementation of programs to ensure they are in accordance with donor and ACF internal requirements. Must develop extensive understanding of donor rules for project under implementation and guide project manager in the reading of the relevant donor rules


Objective 2: Information management/data collection and implementation of quality controls:


	To distribute and share with all ACF staff copies of all documentation (grant proposals, Donor rules, ACF relevant guidelines, reports, budget etc.) related to their specific programs
	Ensure comprehensive grant files are maintained up to date and are available for use (same docs as above)
	To act as an information resource on Borno. In connection with the Field Coordinator, be able to provide informative and varied articles from several sources regarding the current political, socio-economic, security situation in the country. Build a dedicated file to centralize all relevant information on Borno context evolution and development (including Gov and LGA policies, strategies and development plans, resources produced by academics)
	Provide briefing papers and support development of external communication tools as relevant for donor and relevant stakeholders&rsquo; visits/meetings on ACF Nigeria programs in Borno


Objective 3: Support in the ongoing context analysis and scenario planning, risk analysis and advocacy initiatives:


	Participate in all internal program strategy meetings with senior management team in Borno state
	Support field level project proposals development requirements for the ACF Nigeria Borno Program under the supervision of the Field Coordinator.
	Develop stakeholders mapping for each project, notes on advocacy primary and secondary targets (organogram of various institutions and influential members), develop, and follow up implementation of engagement strategies (reports to external stakeholders, advocacy initiatives&hellip;)
	Support to produce bi-annual context review document, scenario planning and Contingency plan review / building.


Mission 4- Support ACF external representation and lead partnership development opportunities:&nbsp;


	Where necessary, support the Field Coordinator in the external representation of ACF and the coordination with government authorities at local, national and state levels (NEMA and SEMA), NGOs and UN agencies; give regular updates to the main stakeholders as necessary
	Ensure that relevant stakeholders have a clear understanding of ACF charter, background, program objectives and activities in the field
	Develop and manage relationships with local NGOs, CBOs, CSOs and academia to support the development of new programming. Act as focal person for those partnership development and management (from selection process to supervision).


Position Requirements


	Bachelor of Arts or Science / Bac+4 (or higher) in International Development, Social Studies, Economics, Humanitarian Assistance, Rural Development, Geography, Agriculture, Livestock or related studies.
	Minimum 2 years of work experience in a similar setting and responsibility.
	Minimum 2 years of humanitarian experience.


Remuneration
Employee Benefits Include (bot are not limited to):


	100% health care coverage
	Free and direct access to Talent Soft e-learning platform
	Maternity or Paternity leave
	Compassionate leave for a hospitalized child
	Creche facilities for babies.


Recruitment Process:


	All shortlisted candidates will undergo thorough reference and background checks, and are expected to adhere to organizational standards and principles.


Note


	Qualified women are strongly encouraged to apply.
	All applicants MUST answer every question in the application form.
	Incomplete applications will not be considered.

For 40 years, the humanitarian and development organization has been on the front lines, treating and preventing hunger across nearly 50 countries. It served more than 21 million people in 2018 alone.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Grants and Compliance Manager

Job Location: Maiduguri, Borno
Employment Type: Full-Time
Reporting to: Field Coordinator
Proposed start date: October 2026

Job Summary
     

            
    




	We are currently looking to fill the role of Grants and Compliance Manager who will be responsible for overseeing all critical aspects of the grant cycle from pre-award to post-award including donor compliance, timely and quality reporting, internal and external coordination.

	Support the Field Coordinator for the collection and dissemination of various contributions from the Project Managers, review and validation by Abuja technical team, dissemination and filing of the validated report

	Support in project implementation and development, including making inputs in the area of risk management, quality of implementation, analysis of challenges faced during implementation, and working with various program teams and key stakeholders to resolve problems in a timely, cost-efficient, and effective manner
	In coordination with the grant Head and deputy head of department, monitor implementation of programs to ensure they are in accordance with donor and ACF internal requirements. Must develop extensive understanding of donor rules for project under implementation and guide project manager in the reading of the relevant donor rules


Objective 2: Information management/data collection and implementation of quality controls:


	To distribute and share with all ACF staff copies of all documentation (grant proposals, Donor rules, ACF relevant guidelines, reports, budget etc.) related to their specific programs
	Ensure comprehensive grant files are maintained up to date and are available for use (same docs as above)
	To act as an information resource on Borno. In connection with the Field Coordinator, be able to provide informative and varied articles from several sources regarding the current political, socio-economic, security situation in the country. Build a dedicated file to centralize all relevant information on Borno context evolution and development (including Gov and LGA policies, strategies and development plans, resources produced by academics)
	Provide briefing papers and support development of external communication tools as relevant for donor and relevant stakeholders’ visits/meetings on ACF Nigeria programs in Borno


Objective 3: Support in the ongoing context analysis and scenario planning, risk analysis and advocacy initiatives:


	Participate in all internal program strategy meetings with senior management team in Borno state
	Support field level project proposals development requirements for the ACF Nigeria Borno Program under the supervision of the Field Coordinator.
	Develop stakeholders mapping for each project, notes on advocacy primary and secondary targets (organogram of various institutions and influential members), develop, and follow up implementation of engagement strategies (reports to external stakeholders, advocacy initiatives…)

	Where necessary, support the Field Coordinator in the external representation of ACF and the coordination with government authorities at local, national and state levels (NEMA and SEMA), NGOs and UN agencies; give regular updates to the main stakeholders as necessary
	Ensure that relevant stakeholders have a clear understanding of ACF charter, background, program objectives and activities in the field
	Develop and manage relationships with local NGOs, CBOs, CSOs and academia to support the development of new programming. Act as focal person for those partnership development and management (from selection process to supervision).


Position Requirements


	Bachelor of Arts or Science / Bac+4 (or higher) in International Development, Social Studies, Economics, Humanitarian Assistance, Rural Development, Geography, Agriculture, Livestock or related studies.
	Minimum 2 years of work experience in a similar setting and responsibility.
	Minimum 2 years of humanitarian experience.


Remuneration
Employee Benefits Include (bot are not limited to):


	100% health care coverage
	Free and direct access to Talent Soft e-learning platform
	Maternity or Paternity leave
	Compassionate leave for a hospitalized child
	Creche facilities for babies.


Recruitment Process:


	All shortlisted candidates will undergo thorough reference and background checks, and are expected to adhere to organizational standards and principles.


Note


	Qualified women are strongly encouraged to apply.
	All applicants MUST answer every question in the application form.
	Incomplete applications will not be considered.

  "@type": "JobPosting",
  "title": "Accountant",
  "description": "HCM Bridges Consulting is a professional HR and recruitment consultancy connecting skilled candidates with reputable employers across Nigeria and Africa.

We are&nbsp;recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Accountant

Job Location: Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary


	We are seeking a qualified and experienced Accountant for a company with operations across multiple branches.
	The successful candidate will oversee accounting functions, ensure accurate financial reporting, maintain effective financial controls and support management decision-making.


Key Responsibilities
Financial Accounting &amp; Reporting:


	Oversee the company&#39;s accounting records and financial transactions.
	Prepare monthly and periodic financial statements and management reports.
	Analyse revenue, expenses, profitability, cash flow and other financial information.
	Review financial records and schedules prepared by the bookkeeping function.
	Ensure accounting records are complete, accurate and maintained on time.


Financial Control &amp; Reconciliation:


	Review bank, cash, sales, purchase, receivable and payable reconciliations.
	Monitor financial transactions across the company&#39;s branches.
	Investigate significant discrepancies and ensure appropriate corrective action.
	Monitor financial controls to reduce errors, losses and unauthorised transactions.
	Review branch financial reports and identify unusual or inconsistent transactions.


Inventory &amp; Cost Accounting:


	Monitor the accounting treatment and valuation of inventory.
	Review stock movement and inventory reports across branches.
	Analyse inventory variances and investigate significant discrepancies.
	Monitor cost of goods sold, gross margins and other relevant financial indicators.
	Support management in analysing the financial implications of bulk purchases and sales.


Accounts Receivable &amp; Payable:


	Oversee customer receivables and supplier payables.
	Review outstanding customer balances and supplier obligations.
	Monitor credit transactions and payment schedules.
	Ensure proper reconciliation of customer and supplier accounts.
	Provide management with updates on significant outstanding balances.


Tax &amp; Statutory Compliance:


	Maintain appropriate records required for tax and statutory compliance.
	Support the preparation and filing of applicable tax returns and statutory obligations.
	Ensure accounting practices comply with relevant accounting standards and applicable regulations.
	Liaise with external accountants, auditors, tax consultants or relevant authorities when required.


Management Support &amp; Financial Analysis:


	Provide management with financial information and analysis to support business decisions.
	Assist in budgeting, forecasting and cash-flow planning.
	Identify financial trends, risks and areas requiring management attention.
	Recommend improvements to accounting processes and financial controls.
	Prepare financial schedules and reports as requested by management.


Qualifications &amp; Experience


	Bachelor&#39;s Degree or HND in Accounting, Finance or a related field.
	3&ndash;5 years of relevant accounting experience.
	Professional accounting qualification such as ICAN, ACCA or equivalent is an advantage.
	Experience in a trading and inventory-based business is an advantage.
	Good knowledge of financial reporting, reconciliations, inventory accounting and statutory compliance.
	Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and accounting software.


Key Skills &amp; Competencies:


	Strong financial and analytical skills.
	Excellent attention to details
	Strong knowledge of accounting principles and financial reporting.
	Good understanding of inventory and cost accounting.
	Strong reconciliation and problem-solving skills.
	Integrity and sound financial judgment.
	Ability to analyse large volumes of transactions and financial data.
	Good communication and reporting skills.
	Ability to manage deadlines and work independently.

        At Firewood Rice Nigeria, we don’t just serve meals - we serve memories. With a deep-rooted love for authentic Nigerian dishes, we’ve built a brand that delivers comfort, flavor, and joy to our customers across Lagos. We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Human Resource Manager
Job Location: Lagos

Key Responsibilities
     

            
    




	Manage the end-to-end recruitment and selection process, from sourcing candidates to onboarding.

	Manage employee attendance, leave, performance, disciplinary matters, and other employee relations issues.
	Support performance management processes, including appraisals, KPIs, and performance improvement plans.
	Coordinate employee onboarding, orientation, training, and development programmes.
	Monitor compliance with company policies and applicable labour laws.
	Handle employee grievances and workplace concerns professionally and confidentially.
	Prepare HR reports and provide management with relevant workforce insights.
	Work closely with department heads to identify staffing needs and address people-related challenges.
	Support payroll administration by ensuring accurate and timely submission of relevant employee information and attendance.
	Promote employee engagement, workplace culture, and staff welfare initiatives.
	Ensure consistent application of HR policies and procedures across the organisation.


Requirements


	Bachelor’s Degree or HND in Human Resources, Business Administration, Industrial Relations, or a related field.
	4–6 years of relevant HR experience, with at least 2 years in a supervisory or managerial capacity.

	Strong knowledge of HR policies, employee relations, recruitment, performance management, and labour practices.
	Excellent communication, interpersonal, and organisational skills.
	Strong problem-solving and decision-making abilities.
	Good knowledge of Microsoft Office and HR management systems.
	Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.

	N250,000 - N300,000 per month.
	Health Maintenance Organization (HMO) coverage.
